data.body: Implementation checkpoint: commit 8a87dff27851dfae89526b3dff59b4d077deab6c (Change-Id I1d2270be824fa4154ca1bae6f336697651b14380) changes exactly the four declared paths and only the 13 allowlisted comments/docstrings.
